description: Phase 4.C PCA48-nearest exemplar selection. Locked N_EXEMPLARS=1. Three conditions: random / nearest / farthest. Same 50 ASINs × 167 (user, asin) pairs. Leakage control: exclude user sentences from target ASIN. Each pair records (exemplar_d_self, query_d_self) for transfer diagnostics.

config.leakage_control: exclude user sentences from target ASIN

rationale: nearest 与 farthest 在 min_d_self 上几乎一样 (Δ=-0.034). LLM 没有把 exemplar 的 PCA48 syntax location 传递到 query. 下一步: Phase 5 — explicit syntax-conditioned generation.
